correctness.rationale: The normalized L²(pi) Rayleigh quotient gives covariance matrix diag(p)-pp^T positive definite since pi0>0. Strong SDP duality gives price-weighted Gram vectors, whose optimal resultant has the exact polygon deficit. Primal vectors explicitly achieve the dual upper bound in both regimes; the imbalanced Schur complement is zero with all other pivots positive. Complementary slackness forces every x_i uniquely because each dual Gram vector has nonzero norm. The slack nullities imply multiplicities; exact rational checks 321 cases supplement rather than replace the infinite-parameter proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural classification of the reversible star budgeted mixing design under independent stationary masses and edge prices, with a sharp polygon threshold, explicit unique conductances, positivity, a spectral multiplicity phase change, and a mass-only transition for equal prices. This is not a mere tabulation or name substitution: it provides decisions invisible to equal-mass star formulas and applicable for any real parameters, including arbitrarily disparate stationary masses.
